extra.message: case_matter_file_048 does not call _wrk_gate() unlike every other ops endpoint, so it has no authentication. Any unauthenticated caller can request /ops/fold/case-matter-file-048/ and receive case_count plus ops_memo containing sensitive operational data (renewal risk, payment flags, owner contact details).

cwe: CWE-306: Missing Authentication for Critical Function

extra.message: case_return_lane_152 reads the redirect target from request.GET['lane'] / request.POST['lane'] and passes it directly to django.shortcuts.redirect() without validating that it is a local path. An attacker can craft /ops/after/case-lane-152/?lane=https://evil.example to send users to an arbitrary external site (open redirect / phishing).

cwe: CWE-601: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect')

extra.message: case_bundle_thaw_177 calls pickle.loads() on bytes taken from the request body (or the base64-decoded request.GET['blob']). pickle deserialization of untrusted data allows arbitrary code execution via crafted __reduce__ payloads.

cwe: CWE-502: Deserialization of Untrusted Data

extra.message: case_wire_tally_217 logs the raw request body together with the Authorization bearer token via logger.warning(). Secrets and sensitive case data written to application logs can be read by anyone with log access or through other log-disclosure paths.

cwe: CWE-532: Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File

extra.message: case_formula_cast_258 passes the user-supplied request.GET['expr'] directly into eval(). The {'__builtins__': {}} restriction is not a sandbox and is trivially bypassable (e.g. via object/subclass traversal), allowing arbitrary Python code execution.

cwe: CWE-95: Improper Neutralization of Directives in Dynamically Evaluated Code ('Eval Injection')

extra.message: case_crumb_lane_295 calls response.set_cookie('portal_crumb', marker) with an attacker-controlled value and without httponly, secure, or samesite flags. The cookie is readable by client-side JavaScript and is transmitted over plaintext HTTP, enabling theft via XSS or network interception.

cwe: CWE-1004: Sensitive Cookie Without 'HttpOnly' Flag
CWE-614: Sensitive Cookie in HTTPS Session Without 'Secure' Attribute

extra.message: case_pulse_spill_348 raises a RuntimeError that embeds the server filesystem path (BASE_EXPORT_DIR) and returns str(exc) plus the exception class to the client in a 500 response. This discloses internal path/configuration details useful for further attacks.

cwe: CWE-209: Generation of Error Message Containing Sensitive Information

extra.message: case_identity_hint_461 validates callers against a hardcoded credential table known = {'north': '4812', 'south': '5930'}. These verifier values are committed in source and can never be rotated; anyone with repository access obtains valid credentials.

cwe: CWE-798: Use of Hard-coded Credentials

extra.message: case_origin_mirror_471 reflects the attacker-controlled Origin header directly into Access-Control-Allow-Origin while also setting Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true. This trusts every origin with credentials, allowing any malicious site to read authenticated responses cross-origin.

cwe: CWE-942: Permissive Cross-domain Policy with Untrusted Domains

extra.message: case_frame_slip_481 explicitly disables browser protections by setting X-XSS-Protection: 0 and an empty Content-Security-Policy header. This weakens defense-in-depth and can enable script execution in the response context.

cwe: CWE-693: Protection Mechanism Failure

extra.message: case_dock_shelf_499 builds target = BASE_EXPORT_DIR / name from request.GET['name'] with no path normalization and then writes request.body to it. A value such as ../../../../tmp/x allows arbitrary file write outside BASE_EXPORT_DIR (path traversal).

cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

extra.message: case_shell_probe_502 concatenates the user-controlled request.GET['host'] into an os.system('ping -c 1 ' + host) shell command. Shell metacharacters (; | & $()) allow arbitrary OS command execution.

cwe: CWE-78: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')

extra.message: case_nonce_roll_511 reads an unbounded integer length from request.GET['length'] and generates that many random characters in memory. A large value (e.g. length=1000000000) exhausts memory/CPU and denies service.

cwe: CWE-770: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling

extra.message: case_nonce_roll_511 generates a security code using random.choice() (Mersenne Twister), which is not cryptographically secure. The nonce is predictable from prior outputs, defeating its purpose as a security token.

cwe: CWE-338: Use of Cryptographically Weak Pseudo-Random Number Generator (PRNG)

extra.message: case_xml_fold_522 parses request.body with lxml etree.XMLParser(load_dtd=True, resolve_entities=True, no_network=False). This explicitly enables external entity resolution, allowing XXE attacks to read local files or reach internal network services.

cwe: CWE-611: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference

extra.message: case_badge_gate_531 grants elevated access (lane=elevated, payroll=full, casework=open) whenever the request presents the hardcoded cookie/header value ops_badge=lead. Because the sentinel 'lead' is public in source, any caller with the ops token can trivially escalate privileges.

cwe: CWE-798: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
CWE-284: Improper Access Control

extra.message: case_mongo_lane_541 passes the attacker-controlled JSON payload['filter'] directly as the MongoClient find_one() query document. Operator injection such as {'$ne': null} or {'$where': ...} bypasses the intended query logic and can expose or alter records.

cwe: CWE-943: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic

extra.message: case_trust_drift_551 uses ssl._create_unverified_context() and passes it to urllib.request.urlopen(), disabling TLS certificate verification. This allows a man-in-the-middle attacker to intercept or spoof the partner connection.

cwe: CWE-295: Improper Certificate Validation
